segments.text: Larger Catechism one hundred and sixty
What is required of those that hear the Word preached
It is required of those that hear the Word preached, that they attend upon it with diligence, preparation, and prayer; examine what they hear by the Scriptures;
receive the truth with faith, love, meekness, and readiness of mind, as the Word of God; meditate, and confer of it;
hide it in their hearts, and bring forth the fruit of it in their lives.
